Jordan: Quick sync — trying to avoid press/marketplace overlap for the next GPU waves (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi). Can we confirm gating windows for SI integration and when we can safely open marketplace SKUs?
Marina: Agree. High-level ask: no marketplace announce in a region until SI cert + driver smoke pass complete.
Vijay: SI team sees Gaudi driver f/w slipping ~10 days on current plan. That will push our partner cert by ~2w.
Anna: If that's true we should delay the marketplace cutover in impacted regions rather than do a partial announce. Marketing will need a clean embargo window.
Jordan: Proposed minimal plan:
- Pause public marketplace announce for affected SKUs until SI cert done
- Ramp internal canaries in non-press regions (APAC staging)
- Provide fallback model variants (quantized/older weights) for Hosted API to avoid customer regressions

Jordan: Quick matrix for discussion:
```
Model    | Region     | Proposed announce window | SI gate
H100     | NA/EU      | 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-17  | cert+fw
H200/B200| Global     | 2026-05-17 -> 2026-05-24  | cert
MI300    | EU/APAC    | 2026-05-24 -> 2026-06-01  | driver+perf
Gaudi    | APAC       | freeze -> canary only    | SI smoke
```
Jordan: Link to current SKU matrix + lab bookings: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/sku-matrix (private)
Marina: On fallbacks — I can prepare a recommended list of model-variant pairings and config flags for runtime to auto-fallback. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Vijay: SI: I'll confirm exact driver drop date by EOD today, and post updated test-grid. If driver lands late, we recommend a 7-day buffer after cert for marketplace announce.
Anna: Marketing: hold embargo ask. We can shift press to the following wave if the 7-day buffer applies. I'll draft an embargo note and share with legal + comms.
Liam: Ops question — do we have capacity reserved for the canaries? We need a small Dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbor issues.
Jordan: Good point. I'll request a 2-GPU Dedicated burst pool for canaries and label it "announce-canary" in infra.
PartnersBot: Calendar: invite created for "HW Vendor Roadmap - marketplace gating" on 2026-04-29 10:00 UTC.
Marina: Action items recap:
- Marina -> fallback model list + config (EOD tomorrow) :thumbsup:
- Vijay -> driver date + SI test-grid (EOD today)
- Anna -> embargo draft + press holding language (tomorrow morning)
- Jordan -> provision canary pool + update runway chart
- Liam -> confirm capacity reservation and tagging

Vijay: Noted. Also tagging partners: @OEM-interfaces for firmware call if needed.
Anna: Thanks — we'll try to keep the public messaging consolidated to avoid confusion.
Jordan: Thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly.
